# TP x STUDIO

> Premier Digital Architecture, Polyglot Engineering, Game Server Hub, and Media Production Studio.

TP x STUDIO is an elite digital agency and technical laboratory specializing in custom full-stack web architecture, artificial intelligence workflows, low-latency game server hosting nodes, 3D voxel game asset creation, and viral social media video production.

- **Website**: https://tpxstudio.vercel.app/

## Core Technical Disciplines

1. **Custom Web Architecture & SaaS Portals**:
   - High-performance, conversion-driven web applications built using Next.js, React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.
   - Guaranteed 100/100 Google Lighthouse scores, sub-second first-contentful paint, server-side rendering (SSR), and automated CI/CD deployment pipelines.
   - Secure Discord OAuth2 authentication, automated rank delivery checkouts, and custom API architectures.

2. **Open-Source AI & Autonomous Workflows**:
   - Autonomous multi-agent swarms, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines, and LangChain orchestration.
   - Vector database design (Pinecone, Qdrant, ChromaDB) and fine-tuned LLM chatbot deployments.
   - 24/7 automated Discord, Telegram, and WhatsApp customer onboarding bots.

3. **Self-Hostable Backend as a Service (BaaS)**:
   - White-label, production-grade backend engine offering visual drag-and-drop database schema creation (PostgreSQL, MongoDB).
   - Auto-generated secure REST & GraphQL endpoints with role-based JWT access controls.
   - Self-hostable on Docker, Railway, Render, or bare-metal VPS ($0 recurring cloud fees).

4. **3D Voxel Models & Engine Assets**:
   - Production-grade Blockbench JSON and OBJ 3D models engineered for Minecraft servers, sandbox game engines, and custom game worlds.
   - Rigging, bone hierarchies, high-FPS polycount optimizations, and custom Java plugin configs (ItemsAdder, Oraxen, MythicMobs).

5. **Low-Latency Game Server Hub (<12ms)**:
   - High-clock frequency CPU game servers hosted in Tier-3/4 Indian datacenters.
   - Enterprise Layer 3/4/7 DDoS mitigation shields, automated daily offsite snapshot backups, and full Pterodactyl console access.
   - BungeeCord and Velocity network proxy routing with 99.9% uptime.

6. **Viral Shorts & Cinema Video Production**:
   - High-retention short-form video editing for Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and TikTok.
   - Kinetic typography, custom audio mastering, sound design (SFX), and gaming storytelling cinema.

## Polyglot Code Capabilities

TP x STUDIO natively develops, audits, and maintains systems across 12 modern programming languages:

- **TypeScript / JavaScript**: Next.js App Router, React, Node.js, Express, Tailwind CSS, Electron.
- **Python**: FastAPI, PyTorch, LangChain, LlamaIndex, automated web scraping, data pipelines.
- **Rust**: High-throughput microservices, WebAssembly (WASM), memory-safe game daemons.
- **Go (Golang)**: High-concurrency microservices, gRPC, containerized backend routing.
- **Java**: Custom Minecraft server plugins (Paper, Spigot, Purpur), backend architectures.
- **C++**: Matrix engines, game simulation physics, high-performance computing modules.
- **Kotlin & Swift**: Native mobile application ecosystems (Jetpack Compose, SwiftUI).
- **Dart / Flutter**: Cross-platform mobile and desktop media applications.
- **C# / .NET**: E-commerce payment connectors, Discord bot frameworks, Windows desktop utilities.
- **SQL / PostgreSQL**: Relational schema architecture, Prisma ORM, indexing optimization.
- **Bash / Shell**: DevOps automation, Docker orchestration, Linux server hardening.
